name: manual_a9a1b6
claim: A safety latch inside a transactional attempt store must be committed to durable storage before raising a refusal; raising inside a rolled-back transaction discards the latch and permits subsequent bypass.

decisions.notes: In the R5 consumer clock race fix (Oramasys PR #71), updating clock_high_water to quarantined=1 inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE commits before authorize_dispatch raises ClockQuarantined, ensuring durable containment across restarts.

rationale: In the R5 consumer clock race fix (Oramasys PR #71), updating clock_high_water to quarantined=1 inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE commits before authorize_dispatch raises ClockQuarantined, ensuring durable containment across restarts.
